title: Bulk Cargo Transport
shortDescription: High-capacity local and cross-border transport of minerals, aggregates, and agricultural commodities.
longDescription: DFS Group provides reliable and efficient transport for high-volume bulk commodities across Southern Africa. Operating a modern fleet of side-tippers, we support mining operations, industrial processes, and agricultural distribution with optimized payload capacities and strict safety compliance.
features: 22.5 m³ side-tippers optimized for dense ores and aggregates
45 m³ high-capacity side-tippers for coal, agricultural bulk, and low-density minerals
Robust route planning minimizing delays on key Southern African transit corridors
On-board load-weighing systems to ensure compliance with axle load limits
Continuous fleet tracking for real-time cargo visibility
safetyPractices: All bulk trailers are fitted with automatic tarping systems to secure loads and prevent dust emissions. Drivers undergo regular defensive driving training and route hazards profiling before deployment.

title: Bagged Cargo Transport
shortDescription: Secure, long-distance transportation of palletized and bagged materials using flat-deck links.
longDescription: Our bagged cargo service delivers high-capacity transit for palletized and stacked commodities. Utilizing Scania flat-deck link combinations, we move materials safely between manufacturing plants, regional distributors, and final delivery sites across borders.
features: Flat-deck link combinations with carrying capacities of up to 36 metric tonnes
Heavy-duty weather-proof cargo covers and specialized lashing straps
Strict cargo securement verification protocols at origin and major check stations
Cost-effective freight rates for long-haul corridor lanes
Frequent transit milestone updates transmitted directly to your operational contact
safetyPractices: All flat-deck loads are secured under strict compliance with regional load-restraint guidelines. Cargo strap tension is monitored during routine driver stops.

title: Cross-Border Logistics
shortDescription: Seamless corridor coordination and freight transit between Botswana, SA, Zambia, and Zimbabwe.
longDescription: Navigating cross-border trade in Southern Africa requires experience, robust route networks, and continuous coordination. DFS Group links the major economic hubs of Gaborone, Johannesburg, Lusaka, and Harare, providing a dependable bridge for regional supply chains.
features: Dedicated border coordination teams at Ramokgwebana, Martins Drift, Kazungula, and Beitbridge
Active documentation pre-clearance checks to minimize border dwell times
Multi-point status updates across regional check stations
Pre-planned routes avoiding high-risk corridors
Ready architecture for future digital waybills and document storage on DFS-OS
safetyPractices: All cross-border units maintain active dual-satellite/cellular tracking to ensure continuous tracking even in remote border locations.

title: Customs Clearing Support
shortDescription: Regulatory guidance and document pre-clearance coordination for import and export goods.
longDescription: Keep your cargo moving without administrative delays. DFS Group supports your business by coordinating all import/export customs clearance requirements, ensuring compliance with local revenue authorities and regional border systems.
features: Customs documentation compilation, check, and pre-filing services
Direct coordination with custom brokers and border agents at major crossings
Assistance with customs valuation, tariff classification (HS codes), and origin rules
Active monitoring of border processing queues and clear communication of release statuses
Preparation for automated customs filing tools in our future DFS-OS system
disclaimer: Disclaimer: DFS Group acts as an advisory and administrative partner for customs documentation. Customers remain legally responsible for supplying complete, truthful, and accurate cargo declarations and regulatory documentation. Final customs decisions, inspections, and duties assessment rest solely with the respective national revenue and border control authorities.
safetyPractices: All client document sets are handled through secure, access-controlled directories to protect business confidentiality and POPIA compliance.

title: Tailored Logistics Solutions
shortDescription: Custom contract transport, dedicated fleet configurations, and industrial project coordination.
longDescription: Some supply chains require dedicated resources and specialized schedules. DFS Group designs tailored logistics solutions to fit contract transport needs, seasonal peaks, and mining project mobilizations.
features: Long-term contract distribution with dedicated truck and trailer options
Customized scheduled shuttle loops between regional supply nodes
Project-based logistics coordination for mine construction or industrial installations
Tailored loading and unloading equipment integrations
Direct system-to-system data integration plans (DFS-OS API)
safetyPractices: Tailored projects are subject to custom Risk Assessments and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) developed in collaboration with client safety departments.
